question: The Kadamba Dynasty was an ancient royal dynasty of the modern day:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Kadamba Dynasty was an ancient royal dynasty of the modern-day **Karnataka**.
 
• The Kadambas (345–525 CE) was an ancient royal family of Karnataka, India, that ruled northern Karnataka and the Konkan from Banavasi in the present-day Uttara Kannada district.
 
 
• **Banavasi **was the capital of the kadambas dynasty.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kakusthavarman (A.D. 435-455)** was the most powerful king and administrator of the Kadamba dynasty.
 
• Kakusthavarman established matrimonial relations with the Gangas and the Guptas (dynasties).
 
• **Mayurasharma **a Kannada scholar and a native of Talagunda was the founder of the Kadamba Kingdom of Banavasi.
 
• Banavasi is said to be the oldest town in Karnataka earlier known as Konkanapura.
 
 
• it is a temple town.
